MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
     CASE
       WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE)
       ELSE CAST(REPLACE(p.death_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)
     END AS end_date
WITH p,
     DATE_PART('year', end_date) - DATE_PART('year', birth_date)
       - CASE
           WHEN DATE_PART('month', end_date) < DATE_PART('month', birth_date)
             OR (DATE_PART('month', end_date) = DATE_PART('month', birth_date)
                 AND DATE_PART('day', end_date) < DATE_PART('day', birth_date))
           THEN 1 ELSE 0
         END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) END AS end_year,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) END AS end_month,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 15 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) END AS end_day
WITH p,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
